data.body_html:
New Year's Eve 2046 in Marbella is a spectacle you won't forget – and the best seat in the house is on the water. With fireworks lighting up the sky over Puerto Banús and Marbella Marina, a private boat rental gives you unobstructed views, your own bar, and zero crowds. Our fleet of 17 boats departs from Puerto Banús, and we've got options from €749/2h to luxury yachts with jet skis. Here's everything you need to know to book your NYE 2046 on the sea.

Why a Boat Is the Best Way to See NYE Fireworks in Marbella

On land, you'll be shoulder-to-shoulder with thousands of revellers along the Paseo Marítimo. On a boat, you can anchor just 200 metres offshore, with a full view of the displays from Cabopino to Estepona. The gentle swell, the glow of the lights on the water, and a glass of cava in hand – it's a completely different experience. Plus, you avoid the traffic jams that clog the Golden Mile after midnight.

Our NYE 2046 Fleet: Which Boat Fits Your Party?

We have boats for every group size and budget. Here's a quick look at the most popular choices for NYE:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – from €749/2h, perfect for a couple or small group
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – from €749/2h, sporty and stylish
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719 min 4h, includes free jet ski
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – flybridge offers panoramic views
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – ultimate luxury, priced on request

For a full list, see our boat rental fleet. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you're right in the heart of the action.

NYE 2046 Pricing: Transparent Rates, No Hidden Costs

We keep pricing simple. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) are €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. That includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA – no surprises. The Mangusta 80 (including the Grey variant) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, and you get a jet ski free to play with before the fireworks. All other boats – like the Canados 86, Ferretti 94, and Maiora 26m – are priced on request via WhatsApp, so message us for a tailored quote.

What's Included in Every NYE Charter

Every boat rental comes with a licensed skipper who knows the best anchoring spots. You'll also get fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA. Want something extra? We can arrange a private chef, DJ, or custom decorations – just let us know when you book.

Best Fireworks Viewing Spots from the Water

Your skipper will position the boat for the best view, but here are the classic NYE spots:

  • Puerto Banús entrance – close to the action, with the marina lights as a backdrop
  • Marbella Marina – a slightly calmer anchorage, still with full views
  • Off the Golden Mile – a bit more space, but you can still see the displays
  • Cala del Faro – a quieter spot if you want a more intimate celebration

In December, the sea temperature is around 15°C, so bring a warm jacket – but the flybridge of boats like the Azimut 58 is the best vantage point.

How to Book Your NYE 2046 Boat

Booking is easy. Visit our homepage to view the full fleet, or contact us directly on WhatsApp for availability and custom quotes. We recommend reserving by November 2046 – NYE is our busiest night, and the most popular boats go fast. A 30% deposit secures your booking, with the balance due 14 days before departure.

What to Expect on the Night

Your charter will start around 22:00, giving you time to cruise along the coast as the sun sets over La Concha. Enjoy the open bar and snacks as you anchor for the countdown. At midnight, the sky erupts in colour, and you'll toast with cava on deck. After the fireworks, you can either head back to port or extend your charter to dance the night away – many guests add an extra hour or two.
